text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't have any plans for my day off, so
I decide
to spend some time around the
station when...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Why hello there, Trainer

<username>! What
perfect
timing! I know this is a bit
sudden, but...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Do you like idols?!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Idols! The singing and dancing
performers that
shine on stage!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You see, there's this brilliant concert I
highly
recommend, and I happen to have
an extra ticket.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Would you be interested in going with
me?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm so pleased we can attend

together. You'll definitely enjoy
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello's impeccable taste in live
shows is
practically a given, considering
her job as an
event producer. The
concert turns out to be a
blast!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was really, really good! I was almost moved to tears!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
And guess what—I made eye contact
with the idol
in the center position!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
She even winked at me! Ohhh, it's no use

resisting. I'm completely spellbound!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You don't get it, do you?! The most vital
tool you
need when watching a concert
is...
choice_data_list: ずいぶん後ろの席でしたけど……

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: The power to live in your own head!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You have to believe the fan service is
directed
only at you! You must have
conviction that your
cheers are reaching
the stage!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I use the power of imagination to fully
embrace
the passionate emotions
delivered by the
performers.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts are wonderful, but idol
concerts
also breathe life into me. I love
them so much!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry for getting a little worked up
there. I
just really lose myself in the
spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Really?! I'm glad to hear it!
choice_data_list: とても勉強になりました

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um... If you're interested, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go to another concert

sometime? I've got a whole bunch of

recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We could share our thoughts about the

performance afterwards, too. I'm sure it
would be
a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I had a truly enjoyable time today. Let's
definitely
do this again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Light Hello continues to passionately
give me her
thoughts on the concert as
we enjoy a lively
journey home.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I-I see! It's only natural that you'd
be busy, I
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... Sorry to invite you like that out of
the blue!
I'll, uh, see you around
sometime...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Light Hello and I go our
separate ways...
